---
title: "Initial filter for all MAPT peptides"
output: html_document
date: "2026-05-08"
---

```{r}
peptides <- read.csv("DRIX168_31032026search_Peptide_level.csv")
#Filter for MAPT peptides and only necessary columns
MAPTpeptides <- peptides %>% filter(Protein.Names == "TAU_HUMAN;cRAP-TAU_HUMAN") %>% select(Run, Stripped.Sequence, Precursor.Quantity)

write.csv(MAPTpeptides, file = "All_MAPT_Peptides.csv")
```
